# Marguerite's Bobbins

*Nana Gristle said the bobbins packed around her mother on the Long Walk were blue, and Ozzie Lantry has never heard that before. Ask Nana about the lace bobbins again, and bring Ozzie boar bristle to bind his swelling notes.*

| Level | 33 |

## Objectives

1. Talk to [Nana Gristle](../npcs/nana_gristle.md)
2. Bring 15 [Boar Bristle](../items/boar_bristle.md) (taken)
